import torch
from tslearn.metrics import soft_dtw

# Test PyTorch backend with automatic differentiation
ts1_pt = torch.tensor(s1, dtype=torch.float64, requires_grad=True)
ts2_pt = torch.tensor(s2, dtype=torch.float64)

sim_pt = soft_dtw(
    ts1=ts1_pt, 
    ts2=ts2_pt, 
    gamma=1.0, 
    be="pytorch", 
    compute_with_backend=True
)

assert -1e-7 < sim_self < 1e-7, f"Expected soft_dtw(s1, s1, gamma=0.0) to be 0.0, got {sim_self}"

print(f"__CHECK__ soft_dtw {sim_self:.4f} {float(sim_pt):.4f} {ts1_pt.grad.shape}")
